preregistration: This lock and model source are committed before the first V3 model inference. Do not select any model, checkpoint, hyperparameter or architecture using V3 labels.

model_lock.model_type: TransformerEncoder + source-literal readout or candidate-masked class logits

metrics_lock.primary: mean of paired both-correct across 7 held-out families (each family averaged across 2 name strata and 5 seeds)
secondary: family-cluster x seed bootstrap percentile interval
metrics_lock.baseline: chance conditional source 25% single; independent candidate both 6.25%, different-label-aware both 8.33%; non-oracle heuristic baseline from AB/CD dev selection; AST symbolic rule upper ceiling
metrics_lock.test_usage: Test may be run only once for each locked arm and seed. Any followups after observing V3 are posthoc and require a new sealed V4 for confirmatory evidence.

decision_gates.precondition: All 20 runs + independent AST ceiling + source-only heuristic audit pass; if pipeline fails, V3 result not confirmatory.
decision_gates.research_go: pointer family-mean paired both-correct >=0.70 AND each family >=0.50 AND positive paired difference vs strongest non-oracle baseline and nearest param-matched ablation.
decision_gates.publication_go: In addition to research_go: externally published symbol-invariant architecture and graph/AST-guided neural baselines actually run under explicitly matched conditions, additional real-code/incomplete-code transfer, independent replication.
decision_gates.scope_limit: Neither source-literal pointer location nor one finite grammar by itself establishes learned lexical binding or ICML novelty.

operational_rules: Commit protocol and locked model code before touching frozen test by model.
Test hash checked before inference and final 5000-step checkpoint only.
Do not use V2 or V3 to revise architecture or optimize hyperparameters.
Record CPU/PyTorch/NumPy versions and seeds; do not claim bitwise cross-machine determinism.
Compiler-provided edges allowed only in explicitly marked oracle/assisted baseline, not as neural input.
